rationale: Build, blood pressure, lipids, A1c, tobacco (quit over 5 years, nicotine negative), family history, liver chemistry and sleep apnea all carry no debit. Class B occupation (site foreman) and three moving violations in three years are the only charges, and together they place the total in the Table 2 band. No DUI, no avocation, and total cover of $1,000,000 sits within the 20x income multiple for age 49. Preferred classes are unavailable because debits are non-zero.
